# Veyvox 1.17.13

## Safe upgrades from original migration 0042

- Recognizes the exact original soundboard migration 0042 hash that some
  legitimate installations recorded before its FK wrapper was corrected.
- Preserves the original applied ledger, native accounts, passwords, messages,
  uploads and settings. Unknown hashes, changed canonical SQL, duplicate/future
  timestamps and interior gaps are still refused; there is no forced repair.
- A network-isolated rehearsal using a copy of the affected VM's database passed
  0049/0050 with native projections and all copied upload files unchanged. This
  rehearsal tests the source correction, not a substitute for final image checks.

## Entorpecido: a new rare Juno card

- One supplied Entorpecido card joins fully supported decks (110 cards with the
  classic deck and existing memory card). It plays over any face/color, keeps the
  current color and affects the next player for one turn only.
- A valid ordinary play has a server-decided 50% chance to misfire: the cards stay
  in hand, the player draws two and passes. Wrong-card feedback is private to its
  owner; opponents and spectators never receive that hand card.
- Wild cards instead have a 50% chance to choose one of the three other colors,
  without the extra two-card punishment. Existing +4 legality and penalties stay.
- Supplied original artwork/audio, scoped haze, localized rules/status and static
  reduced-motion feedback reuse the existing Juno presentation and SFX controls.
- Capability negotiation keeps older hosts and mixed-client decks playable;
  compatibility never automatically replays a mutation. Bots follow the same
  authoritative rules, and practice/XP behavior is unchanged.

## Upgrade notice

**Back up the database and uploads before upgrading.** The standalone migrations
0049/0050 permanently retire federation-only data and obsolete columns while
preserving native content. Never force the ledger or run older code against an
upgraded database. A rollback requires the matching pre-upgrade data backup.

The previous image scan recorded two moderate Debian libsrt findings; a successful
workflow is not a claim of a vulnerability-free image. Desktop signing/platform
limitations remain unchanged. Publishing this release does not itself deploy it.

## Português (Brasil)

A 1.17.13 corrige a atualização de bancos com o hash original legítimo da migração
0042, sem adulterar o histórico. A carta rara **Entorpecido** pode ser jogada sobre
qualquer carta e afeta o próximo jogador por uma jogada: há 50% de chance de errar,
comprar duas e passar; no coringa, há 50% de escolher outra cor, sem essa punição
extra. Arte e áudio enviados foram integrados, com efeito visual e redução de
movimento. **Faça backup do banco e dos uploads antes de atualizar.**
